req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-034 requires that every player response from GET /players/{id} includes the 'position' field. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — a mid-range player UUID returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty 'position' key whose exact value matches the seeded data; (2) NEG negative — a non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404, confirming the error pathway; (3) BVA boundary — the first seeded player (squad 1, lowest boundary) and last seeded player (squad 26, highest boundary) both return 'position' with exact expected values, catching off-by-one or field-omission mutations; (4) DT decision-table — verifies that 'position' is present and non-null for a player with optional fields set to null/empty, ensuring the field is always included regardless of optional field state; (5) EP positive — verifies the camelCase alias 'position' key is present in the raw JSON body (not just the Pydantic model), catching serialization mutations.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_returns_position_field_exact_value
preconditions: Player with id '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802' exists with position 'Defensive Midfield'
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_player_by_id_returns_position_field_exact_value():
    client = TestClient(app)
    player_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'position' in body
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1

tests.name: test_get_player_position_present_in_raw_json_response_body
preconditions: Player with id 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6' has position 'Right Winger'
actions: Inspect raw response body for 'position' key
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must appear in serialized JSON payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import json

def test_get_player_position_present_in_raw_json_response_body():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    raw = json.loads(r.text)
    assert 'position' in raw
    assert raw['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert raw['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert raw['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'
